observed_model_metadata.lookup_method: Latest complete same-stream turn_context not later than the usage event, backward bounded-memory scan.
observed_model_metadata.scope: Observed configured identifier only; exact serving snapshot/seed/temperature unknown. No cross-stream inference and no historical token recovery.

translation_tokens.scope: Declared translation activity window, repeated/cached context and notifications included. Cached input and reasoning are subsets; no exclusive billing/historical recovery. Shared native, measurement repair, verification and annotation windows separate and may overlap.

context_reuse: Ordered CUDAjl thenKA thenJACC in inherited root stream; native C ABI reused, CUDAjl creates common Julia loop, KA/JACC reuse. CUDAjl/KA additional symmetric v2 remeasurement is shared phase, not additional translation candidate.
interleaving: CCL target work plus notifications. KA includes shared allocator diagnostic and verifier config-guard repair; JACC includes independent saved-input audit setup. Shared measurement repair window includes other benchmark commits/coordination.
candidate_count_unit: Distinct authored framework host program; allocator-policy/timeout diagnostic is another MPI job of the same KA source, not a new device-kernel candidate.
compiler_checks_unit: Two-rank complete Julia program MPI jobs; authored-device JIT count0. Additional accepted v2 CUDAjl/KA measurements separately recorded.
publication_accounting_copy_scope: Annotation-only per-target manifest copy, not an executed dependency.
